name: exchange rates
description: What one unit of a currency is worth in another, as at an instant: the latest daily rate NetSuite holds on or before that day. An amount in from_currency times rate is the amount in to_currency.

from_currency.description: The currency an amount is in.

to_currency.description: The currency it is converted to.

rate.description: Units of to_currency per unit of from_currency.
